args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to flawfinder; each item is a single argument string

minlevel.description: Minimum risk level (0-5) to include in the report; default 1

error_level.description: If any hit with this level or higher is found, exit with nonzero status; 0 means no error exit

input_sources.description: List of source files or directories to analyze

cwe_filter.description: Regular expression to filter reported hits to those matching at least one CWE

include_context.description: Include source code line of each hit in output

include_columns.description: Include column number in each hit

ignore_directives.description: Respect 'Flawfinder: ignore' directives in source; set false to force --neverignore

patch_file.description: Path to unified diff file; only report hits on changed lines (--patch)

diff_hitlist.description: Show only hits not in reference hitlist file (--diffhitlist)
